concerns.text: Verification for T009 includes a manual visual inspection step ('Visual inspection (manual step) shows τ² on the x‑axis and coverage / mean bias on the y‑axis with 95 % CI error bars'), which cannot be executed deterministically by an automated agent. Replace the manual check with an automated image validation (e.g., checking image dimensions, presence of expected axis labels via OCR, or pixel‑wise comparison to a reference) to make the verification fully executable.
